flashcard_questions.q: The Treaty of Versailles was signed at the Palace of Versailles on ____.
What does the German word Diktat mean?
flashcard_questions.a: A dictated peace, accepted with no discussion allowed.

flashcard_questions.q: How many men was the German army limited to?
How many battleships was the German navy allowed?
For how long was the Rhineland occupied by Allied troops?
What share of its land did Germany lose under the Treaty?
What share of its population did Germany lose under the Treaty?
Which region was returned to France in 1919?
Who was given the Saar coalfields for fifteen years?
flashcard_questions.a: France, under League of Nations control.

flashcard_questions.q: What share of its coal did Germany lose?
Which German-speaking union did the Treaty ban?
How much were reparations finally set at in 1921?
When was Germany expected to finish paying reparations?
What did Article 231 force Germany to accept?
flashcard_questions.a: Total blame for starting the war.

flashcard_questions.q: Why did the Allies need the War Guilt Clause?
flashcard_questions.a: Without it they had no legal basis for the other punishments.

notes: 15 cards: 7 figure (army, navy, land, population, coal, reparations, 1988), 3 term-to-definition, 3 territorial, 2 cause-effect. One cloze on the signing date. Kept only one card per statistic.
